title: SD memory card host: CMD0 / CMD8 / ACMD41 / CMD2 / CMD3 / CMD7 initialisation, then repeated CMD24 write, CMD17 read-back compare and CMD13 status rounds in 4-bit mode, with R1 / R2 / R3 / R6 / R7 checks, CRC7 and CRC16

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: a response, CRC status, read block or busy phase failed (framing, CRC7, index, card-status error bits, R7 contents, negative CRC status, CRC16, end bit, read compare, timeout); the host retries

notes: sd_clk (PCLK / ID_CLK_DIV = PCLK / 128 during card identification, which keeps it at 400 kHz or less for PCLK up to 51.2 MHz; PCLK / SD_CLK_DIV = PCLK / 4 from CMD7 on), cmd and dat[3:0] (bidirectional, need pull-ups) are the SD bus; they pass through unchanged. CMD and DAT change on the sd_clk falling edge and are sampled on the rising edge; a response is looked for from N_CR = 2 clocks after the command. The host initialises the card and runs its write / read-back rounds on its own after reset.
Blocks are 32 bytes (the slice's simplification of 512).
